title: Write and solve systems of linear equations for real-world problems

sections.skill: Write and solve systems of linear equations for real-world problems

questions.skill: Write and solve systems of linear equations for real-world problems
questions.prompt: A school sells 200 tickets. Adult tickets cost $6 and student tickets cost $4. The sales total $940. Write a system and solve it to find how many of each ticket were sold.
questions.prompt_markup:
A school sells 200 tickets. Adult tickets cost $6 and student tickets cost $4. The sales total $940.
Write a system and solve it to find how many of each ticket were sold.
questions.correct_answer: The system a + s = 200 and 6a + 4s = 940, and the answer 70 adult and 130 student tickets
questions.grading_note: Both parts are required: a valid equation (or system) and the correct solution. Any valid model is accepted, but the solution must also be correct.

Plan A costs $15 plus $0.05 per minute. Plan B costs $0.10 per minute.
Write a system and solve it to find when the plans cost the same.
questions.correct_answer: The system c = 15 + 0.05m and c = 0.10m, and the answer 300 minutes (both cost $30)
questions.grading_note: Both parts are required: a valid equation (or system) and the correct solution. Any valid model is accepted, but the solution must also be correct.
